entities.summary: Reinhard Skricek is a retired boxer from Germany, who represented West Germany (FRG) at the 1976 Summer Olympics in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. There he won the bronze medal in the welterweight division after being defeated in the semifinals by eventual silver medalist Pedro Gamarro of Venezuela.
